description: Glassdoor job search: title, employer, employer rating, location, Glassdoor's estimated pay range (p10/p50/p90 with period and currency), age in days, easy-apply flag and link for up to 30 jobs, plus the total count. US-wide by keyword, or one city when you pass Glassdoor's city id (the IC number in a Glassdoor jobs URL, e.g. 1139761 = Austin, 1148170 = Denver). Via a residential proxy. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

cityId.description: Optional Glassdoor city id (digits after IC in a Glassdoor jobs URL), e.g. 1139761 for Austin, TX
